records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心護城河在於其「全端加速運算平台」——結合領先的 GPU 硬體、CUDA 軟體開發平台、豐富的領域專屬軟體庫與 API，並透過數百萬開發者與廣大生態系的深度整合，提供從資料中心到終端裝置的完整 AI 基礎建設【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

- GPU 與 CUDA：NVIDIA 以 GPU 為硬體基礎，並於 2006 年推出 CUDA，使得平行運算能力可被廣泛應用於 AI、資料分析、科學運算、機器人與 3D 圖形等多元工作負載【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 完整軟體堆疊：公司提供包括 NVIDIA AI Enterprise、NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等全套軟體套件，讓企業能在同一平台上完成模型訓練、微調、部署與安全防護【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 生態系規模：全球已有超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）開發者使用 CUDA 及其他工具，並透過 Inception 計畫、Deep Learning Institute 等與大學、初創公司及雲端服務商緊密合作，形成難以被競爭者快速複製的開發者網路【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 極致協同設計：NVIDIA 在 Blackwell 架構下，將晶片、互連、系統、軟體與演算法全方位共同設計，讓數十萬顆 GPU 能夠串接成單一巨型電腦，滿足現代 AI 與加速運算的規模需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

這些硬體、軟體與生態系的深度整合，使 NVIDIA 能在 AI、資料中心、電腦圖形與自動駕駛等多個數十億美元的市場中保持領先，形成其最關鍵的技術護城河【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #120】【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #40】。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過以 GPU、CPU、CUDA 與高效能互連技術（如 NVLink）為核心的可程式化統一底層架構，讓同一套平台同時服務資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。

- **資料中心**：NVIDIA 的 Compute & Networking 事業部提供加速運算與網路平台、AI 軟體與解決方案，這些產品皆建構在同一套包含 GPU、CPU、互連與軟體堆疊的架構上，能在雲端、超大規模與邊緣資料中心交付高效能、低功耗的運算資源【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。  
- **遊戲**：GeForce RTX 系列 GPU、Ray Tracing、DLSS 以及 RTX GPU 中的 Tensor Core，都直接繼承自資料中心使用的加速運算技術，透過相同的可程式化平台提供更流暢、更高畫質的遊戲體驗【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。  
- **專業視覺化**：RTX PRO GPU 亦採用與資料中心相同的 Tensor Core 與 AI 加速能力，讓設計、工程與數位內容創作等工作流程受益於同一套 GPU 與軟體堆疊，提升生產力與新功能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。  
- **車用**：在 Automotive 市場，NVIDIA 以 DRIVE Hyperion 平台結合 DRIVE AGX 硬體、車載作業系統（DRIVE OS）與模組化軟體平台，全部基於相同的 AI 加速與互連技術，提供從雲端到車端的全堆疊自動駕駛解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】。  

因此，NVIDIA 以「同一套底層架構」的策略，透過共享的 GPU、CPU、CUDA、互連與軟體生態系，讓多元且規模龐大的市場皆能從同一平台獲得加速與創新效益【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過將 AI 助手 Copilot 直接嵌入 Microsoft 365 產品與服務，讓其成為雲端版 Microsoft 365 商務套件的核心功能，並以此推動使用者每位收入與使用量的提升【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。

- 在 Productivity and Business Processes 版塊中，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 明確列出「Microsoft 365 Copilot」為產品組合的一部份，與 Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams 等服務共同提供【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）報告指出，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 收入成長 19%，其主要驅動力來自 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶來的每位使用者收入提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 同期成本因「支援 Microsoft 365 Copilot 座位與使用量增長」而上升 $680 億美元，顯示公司正投入 AI 基礎設施以支撐 Copilot 的運作【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 產品策略層面，Microsoft 明確表示，未來成長將仰賴「在核心產品與服務中加入 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 場景」，包括在溝通、協作、分析、安全、合規等多個 AI 商務生產力領域中擴展 Copilot 的應用【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 在公司整體業務說明中，Copilot 被歸類於「Productivity and Business Processes」版塊，與 Windows、Office、LinkedIn、Dynamics 等其他產品共同構成 AI 驅動的生產力生態系統【MSFT_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  

因此，Microsoft 的策略是把 Copilot 作為 Microsoft 365 雲端服務的 AI 核心，透過提升每位使用者的功能與價值、擴大商務與消費者版的使用者基數，並同步加大 AI 基礎設施與研發投入，以實現產品差異化與收入成長。

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 商業版的銷售與功能整合，直接提升 Microsoft 365 商業雲端收入，進而帶動以 Copilot 為核心的 AI 服務使用率提升。  

- 在 FY2026，Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品收入因 Windows 商業版的本機元件貢獻而成長 **13%**，而同時 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入因 Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 E5 方案推動，增長 **17%**【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #127】。  
- 在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的六個月期間，Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品收入因 Windows 商業版的本機元件貢獻而成長 **15%**，而 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入同樣因 Microsoft 365 Copilot 推動，增長 **17%**【MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #75】。  
- 微軟在其 10‑K 文字說明中明確指出，利用 Windows 來「fuel our cloud business」是提升雲端服務參與度的關鍵策略之一，並將 Windows 與雲端、AI 服務（包括 Copilot）緊密結合，以提升客戶在多雲與混合環境中的使用率【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #33】。  

因此，Windows 商業版的銷售與功能深度整合，為 Microsoft 365 商業雲端提供基礎用戶與收入增長，同時透過 Copilot 等 AI 產品的嵌入，進一步提升雲端服務的參與度與價值。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在透過持續提升 AWS 基礎設施、擴大 AI/機器學習相關人力與設備，同時以大量股權投資 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 來加速其 AI 服務布局【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #97】。

**1. 基礎設施與 AI/ML 相關支出持續增加**  
- 公司預期未來「技術與基礎設施」支出將持續上升，因為要新增基礎設施與員工以支援人工智慧與機器學習計畫，短期內可能壓縮自由現金流【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #97】。  
- 2025 年技術與基礎設施成本較前一年上升，主要來自基礎設施支出（包括折舊與攤銷），且匯率變動使成本額外增加 **3.12 億美元（$312 million）**【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119】。  
- 2026 年第二季及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的六個月，技術與基礎設施成本再次因基礎設施支出（含折舊與攤銷）上升；六個月總成本較去年同期增加 **4.27 億美元（$427 million）**（外匯影響不顯著）【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79】。

**2. 投資重點聚焦於 AWS 及相關服務**  
- Amazon 強調將資金投入 AWS，提供「即時運算、儲存、資料庫、分析與機器學習」等即服務（on‑demand）與固定容量（fixed‑quantity）方案，並在客戶使用服務時依使用量認列收入【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #150】。  
- 基礎設施成本包括伺服器、網路設備與資料中心相關折舊與攤銷，這些支出直接支撐 AWS 的規模與效能【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119】。

**3. 與 Anthropic 的合作與投資安排**  
- 2026 年第一季 Amazon 投入 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並於同季簽署一項最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的融資設施，允許 Anthropic 在達成特定運算容量里程碑後提取資金（以可轉換債或未來普通股形式）【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。  
- 2026 年第二季又投入 **137 億美元（$13.7 billion）** 於 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，顯示 Amazon 透過股權投資加深在先進生成式 AI 領域的布局【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。

**4. 與 OpenAI 的合作與股權承諾**  
- 2026 年第一季 Amazon 投入 **150 億美元（$15.0 billion）** 購買 OpenAI Series C 優先股，並簽署承諾書（Letter Agreement），同意在未來以 **350 億美元（$35.0 billion）** 的總價購買更多 Series C 優先股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。  
- 這些投資在資產負債表上列為「非按比例合併的私募股權投資」，以 Level 3 公允價值計量，未來若 OpenAI 完成 IPO 或其他流動性事件，優先股將轉換為普通股【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。

**5. 長期資本支出與技術佈局**  
- Amazon 表示，技術與基礎設施成本大多「即時費用化」(expensed as incurred)，但同時持續在衛星寬頻、自治車輛、創新軟硬體等多元領域投入資本，以支援跨地域與跨產品線的擴張【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119】。  

綜合以上，Amazon 的投資策略是：**持續加碼 AWS 基礎設施與 AI/ML 人力資本，透過大量股權與融資承諾深耕 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 等前沿 AI 公司，同時以資本支出支撐雲端、衛星與自動駕駛等長期技術平台**。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在面臨多項與反壟斷與監管相關的風險，主要集中在其電商平台（包括實體與線上商店、物流履約網路與 Prime 服務）以及雲端服務 AWS 上【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】。  

1. **競爭與消費者保護調查**  
   - 美國、加拿大、英國等多個司法管轄區的政府與監管機構正對 Amazon 的商店營運、履約網路、Prime 會員服務以及 AWS 雲端服務展開正式或非正式的審查與調查，指稱其可能違反競爭法或消費者保護規定【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125】。  
   - Amazon 表示已強力否認這些指控，並將「積極且徹底」地為自己辯護【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125】。

2. **反壟斷訴訟與索賠**  
   - 自 2020 年以來，私人原告、州檢察總長與美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）在美國、加拿大與英國提起多起反壟斷與消費者保護訴訟，指控 Amazon 進行價格固定、濫用市場支配地位、濫用資料、操控 Prime 結構等行為【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
   - 這些訴訟要求「數十億美元」的賠償，並包括三倍賠償、懲罰性賠償、禁令救濟、結構性救濟、民事罰款、律師費與其他費用【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  

3. **AWS Nitro 系統的專利侵權指控**  
   - 2025 年 6 月，Xockets, Inc. 在德克薩斯州西區聯邦法院對 Amazon.com, Inc. 與 Amazon Web Services, Inc. 提起兩項訴訟，指稱某些版本的 AWS Nitro 系統侵犯多項美國專利（例如專利號 11,080,209、10,649,924 等）【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
   - 此專利侵權指控屬於知識產權爭議，並未被描述為競爭法調查。  

綜合以上，Amazon 在電商與雲端兩大核心業務上同時面臨反壟斷調查、巨額賠償訴訟以及專利侵權指控，這些風險可能導致高額罰款、訴訟成本、營運限制或聲譽受損。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 把 Gemini AI 深度嵌入搜尋與其他核心產品，讓使用者能以自然語言、多人模態的方式取得更智慧的回應，同時在工作、雲端與多個高流量服務中提供 AI 功能【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **搜尋（Search）**：Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力被納入 Google Search 的「AI Overviews」與「AI Mode」功能，讓使用者可以提出更自然、複雜的問題，系統會以 Gemini 生成的回應直接顯示在搜尋結果中【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- **產品生態系**：Alphabet 表示，全部 15 個「半億使用者」的產品（其中七個產品的使用者超過二十億）皆使用 Gemini 模型，這包括 Search、Gemini App 以及其他未具名的服務【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- **Google Workspace**：在企業協作套件中，Google 以「Gemini for Google Workspace」的形式將 Gemini AI 整合至 Gmail、Docs、Drive、Meet 等雲端工具，提供 AI 助手功能【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #100】。  
- **Google Cloud**：對外雲端客戶，Google 透過「Gemini Enterprise」與「Gemini for Google Workspace」等服務，將 Gemini AI 作為企業 AI 基礎設施與平台的一部分，支援客戶在自家產品中使用 Gemini 的能力【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #100】。  

以上說明顯示，Google 透過 Gemini 模型在搜尋介面、企業協作工具以及雲端服務等多個層面實現 AI 功能的統合與擴散。

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app. As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. We continue to help our users access information and knowledge, express themselves, and get things done by embedding the power of generative AI and Gemini into our products and platforms. Today, all 15 of our half-billion-user products — including seven with two billion users — use our Gemini models. records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過大型語言模型的加入，從傳統關鍵字查詢演變成可直接以自然語句提問並即時得到 AI 產生的概覽與多輪、跨媒體回應的 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 兩項功能【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  

- AI Overviews 讓使用者只要輸入問題，就能在搜尋結果頁面直接取得「更有幫助的回應」​，即透過生成式 AI 提供即時概括​【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- AI Mode 則允許使用者提出更為細緻的問題，這類問題在過去可能需要多次搜尋才能完成，因為它利用 Gemini 的先進推理、思考與多模態能力來處理​【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- 這兩項 AI 功能是 Alphabet 在 2025 年持續將生成式 AI 融入搜尋與其他產品服務的具體表現，並可能改變未來的營收成長率與毛利結構，因為 AI 產品的貨幣化模式與傳統廣告收入不同​【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。  
- 同時，Alphabet 也指出 AI 產品的競爭日益激烈，這促使公司在技術基礎設施（如伺服器、GPU、TPU）上加大投資，以支撐 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 所需的運算資源​【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「下一代計算平台」——結合元宇宙（metaverse）沉浸式體驗與能夠超越人類智慧的 AI，並以 Reality Labs 為核心持續投入 AI 與硬體研發，以實現個人超智慧（personal superintelligence）【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。

**願景與投資方向的具體說明**

1. **下一代計算平台與元宇宙**  
   - Meta 認為元宇宙是「超越二維螢幕的具身化網路」，將成為未來社交科技的演進方向，並以此作為建構新平台的核心【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
   - 目標是透過 AI、穿戴裝置與 VR/Horizon 裝置，打造完整的生態系統，而非單一產品【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

2. **AI 研發與模型訓練**  
   - 持續加大 AI 模型的開發與訓練投入，預期未來會「持續增加這些投資」【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。  
   - AI 投資支援內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及內部產品開發效率【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

3. **Reality Labs 的資金配置**  
   - 2026 年預計將 Reality Labs 營運費用的 **70%** 用於穿戴裝置（wearables）計畫，**30%** 用於 VR 與 Horizon 計畫【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #26】。  
   - 這些投資包括 VR、Horizon、穿戴裝置以及相關基礎設施、隱私、安全與合規等領域【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。

4. **財務影響**  
   - 2025 年 Reality Labs 的投資已使整體營業利潤下降約 **191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）**，且預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67】。

5. **風險與不確定性**  
   - 元宇宙的市場接受度仍不確定，若未達預期將對營運、聲譽與財務結果產生不利影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
   - Meta 在消費者硬體（尤其是 AR/VR）方面的經驗相對有限，可能讓其他公司更有效率地競爭【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #56】。  
   - 投資可能分散管理資源，並受限於隱私、AI、競爭、內容管制、醫療器材、關稅、出口管制等法規的變動，進一步增加營運成本或延遲產品開發【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】、【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #54】。

**總結**  
Meta 正以 AI 與 Reality Labs 為雙引擎，聚焦於穿戴裝置、VR/Horizon 以及大規模 AI 模型的研發，旨在打造「下一代計算平台」與元宇宙生態系，同時承受因高額投資而導致的營運虧損與多重市場與法規風險。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的廣告獲利模式是以「總廣告收入 ÷ 投放廣告數量」計算每則廣告的平均價格，並可透過調整廣告的數量與頻率來優化營收；Meta AI 則作為跨平台助理，嵌入所有 Meta App 中，負責內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告工具以及生成式 AI 體驗【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

- **廣告獲利模式細節**  
  - 平均每則廣告價格＝總廣告收入除以交付的廣告數量，代表行銷人員為每則廣告所支付的平均價格【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
  - 若 Meta 不是收入的主要方，相關廣告收入會以淨額認列【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
  - 廣告的投放量與頻率會因產品（如 Feed、Stories、Reels）以及公司調整的產品與貨幣化策略而增減【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
  - 2026 年第一季廣告平均價格較 2025 年同期上升 12%，顯示單則廣告的收益提升【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #56】。  
  - 同期廣告曝光量（ad impressions）提升 19%，說明投放的廣告總量亦在成長【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #56】。  
  - 除廣告外，Meta 亦有「其他收入」來源，包括 WhatsApp 付費訊息、Meta Verified 訂閱等【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。

- **Meta AI 在 App 中的角色**  
  - Meta AI 是一個跨平台的助理，能在 Meta 的各個 App（如 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等）以及獨立的 AI 應用、AI 眼鏡與網路上使用【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
  - AI 投資支援內容排序（ranking）與發現引擎（recommendation），提升使用者在 App 中看到的相關內容【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
  - AI 亦提供廣告工具，協助廣告主更精準地觸及目標受眾【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
  - 生成式 AI 體驗（generative AI experiences）由 Meta AI 驅動，讓使用者在 App 中創作與互動的方式更具創新性【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
  - 同時，Meta AI 也用於提升產品開發與內部效率，支援系統與工具的自動化與智慧化【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

總結來說，Meta 透過廣告收入除以廣告投放量的方式確定每則廣告的平均價值，並可靈活調整廣告數量與頻率；而 Meta AI 則作為全平台的智能助理，深度嵌入所有主要 App，提供內容排序、推薦、廣告支援與生成式 AI 體驗，進一步提升使用者體驗與廣告效益。

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術作為與競爭對手的核心差異化，主要是透過全車系皆具備的 AI 驅動自動化功能、內部自行設計的推論晶片、持續的 OTA 軟體升級，以及以 FSD 訂閱與 Robotaxi 服務為基礎的全新服務模式來實現【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

- **全車系 AI 自動化設計**：Tesla 表示「每一台今天交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，且認為其 AI 能力「使我們與競爭者區隔」【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **自有硬體與軟體堆疊**：公司使用「自家設計的自訂推論晶片」加速視覺與神經網路訓練，並自行開發大部分車內軟體與使用者介面，透過 OTA 更新不斷提升功能與安全性【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **FSD（Supervised）與訂閱模式**：FSD（Supervised）在全球多個區域以「FSD (Capability)」稱呼，並提供訂閱服務，讓客戶持續取得最新的自動駕駛功能，形成以軟體為主的持續營收來源【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **Robotaxi 服務作為新商業模型**：2025 年 6 月推出的 Robotaxi 服務，使用 Model Y（未來將換成 Cybercab）作為自動駕駛共享平台，藉此將 FSD 技術轉化為「以 AI、軟體與車隊利潤為基礎的服務驅動商業模式」【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **AI 與自動駕駛的整體定位**：Tesla 在 10‑K 中明確指出，公司「專注於將 AI 帶入現實世界」並以 FSD（Supervised）與 Robotaxi 為核心產品，認為這些技術與其垂直整合的商業模式共同構成與其他汽車製造商的根本差異【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **持續的研發與安全承諾**：Tesla 持續投資於自動駕駛與 AI 研發，並透過 OTA 更新「不斷改進」車輛的安全與便利功能，這種快速迭代能力也是其與傳統汽車廠商的關鍵區別【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

綜合以上，Tesla 透過全車系 AI 設計、專屬硬體、軟體訂閱與 Robotaxi 服務，將 FSD/Autopilot 轉化為技術與商業雙重的差異化優勢，形成與競爭對手明顯的競爭壁壘【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #155】。

Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨「競爭激烈且持續加劇」的局面，來自既有大型車廠與新興電動車／自動駕駛公司雙重壓力。  

- 競爭對手包括「已建立且資源更充足的傳統汽車製造商」以及「新進入電動與替代燃料車市場的公司」，這些對手在設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣與售後服務上皆具規模與成本優勢，可能導致 Tesla 的車輛銷量下降、價格被迫下調、營收受挫，甚至失去市場佔有率【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59】。  
- 在能源發電與儲能領域，Tesla 亦面臨「其他製造商、開發商、安裝商與服務提供者」的競爭，且若電力零售或批發價格下降，亦可能削弱其產品吸引力並增加客戶違約風險【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59】。  
- 產品層面上，Tesla 的各車系分別與不同細分市場的競爭對手較量：  
  * Cybertruck 與其他「皮卡」競爭；  
  * Model S 與 Model X 主要對抗「高階轎車」與「高階 SUV」；  
  * Model 3 與 Model Y 則在「小至中型轎車」與「緊湊型 SUV」市場與眾多競爭者較勁【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43】。  
- 這些競爭產品大多為「內燃機車」以及「混合動力（含插電式混合）車」的傳統製造商，同時越來越多製造商已在美國、中國、歐洲等主要市場推出電動車，進一步提升市場競爭程度【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43】。  

總結而言，Tesla 必須在車輛技術、成本效益、產品定位與服務支援上持續創新，才能在「高度競爭且不斷擴大的電動車與自動駕駛市場」中維持其競爭力。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
能源生成與儲能業務是特斯拉的兩大事業部之一，且公司將其視為提供擴張機會與競爭優勢的關鍵事業【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。

- **事業部定位**：特斯拉在 2025 年的營運分為「Automotive」與「Energy Generation and Storage」兩個主要部門【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。能源生成與儲能部門涵蓋太陽能板、太陽能屋頂、Powerwall、Megapack 等住宅、商業與工業客戶的發電與儲能產品，並提供相關安裝、維修、保固與融資服務【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- **競爭優勢**：公司認為其能源儲存產品具備「規格與功能、強勢品牌、模組化與可擴展性」等特點，因而在市場上取得競爭優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。在能源發電方面，特斯拉主打產品的美觀、卓越效能以及與 Powerwall 的整合便利性，認為這些因素為公司帶來顯著的擴張機會【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。

- **策略角色**：2025 年的 10‑K 表示，特斯拉以「差異化且高效管理的產品組合」為基礎，追求盈利成長與長期成長機會，能源生成與儲能業務是此產品組合的重要組成部分之一【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #102】。公司同時強調透過垂直整合、供應鏈本地化以及全球基礎設施（含服務與充電網路）擴張，來支撐包括能源業務在內的整體成長【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #102】。

- **實際部署規模**：2025 年特斯拉已部署 46.7 GWh 的能源儲存產品，顯示該部門在實體產出與市場滲透上具備可觀規模【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #102】。  

綜合上述，能源生成與儲能業務不僅是特斯拉的核心事業部之一，亦透過產品差異化、品牌與模組化優勢，為公司提供長期成長與獲利的多元化支撐。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年 10‑K 中直接說明，它在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦 (PC) 與平板電腦 (tablet) 市場僅擁有「少數」(minority) 市佔，且這些市場的競爭極為激烈，主要來自具備龐大技術、行銷、分銷與資金資源的對手，這些對手常以 aggressive pricing、低成本結構以及快速模仿 Apple 產品功能的方式來爭奪市場份額【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

- 競爭壓力方面，Apple 強調這些市場「高度競爭且特徵為激烈的價格競爭、毛利率下行壓力、產品性能持續提升以及消費者與企業對價格的敏感度」；同時指出競爭者會「積極降價、降低產品毛利率，甚至以幾乎無利潤或虧損的方式提供產品」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- Apple 亦提到，競爭者往往「擁有廣泛的產品線、低價產品、大量活躍裝置安裝基礎與龐大客戶基礎」，且會「模仿 Apple 的產品特性與應用，甚至侵害其智慧財產權」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #39】。  
- 由於上述因素，Apple 必須持續投入大量研發，以確保「持續且及時推出創新新產品、服務與技術」來維持競爭優勢【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

總結來說，Apple 自己在 10‑K 中承認在智慧型手機、PC 與平板市場的市佔僅屬少數，並描述了來自資源豐富、價格激進且善於模仿的競爭者所帶來的強大競爭壓力。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過 **App Store 佣金機制、讓開發者的收入與平台使用者基礎緊密掛鉤，並以「感知利益」與「市場位置」等因素與 Android、Windows、PlayStation、Nintendo、Xbox 等競爭平台比較**，來建立第三方開發者的黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。

- **App Store 佣金與分潤**：Apple 透過 App Store 向第三方應用與數位服務銷售抽取佣金；若開發者改用直接對消費者的分銷與付款模式，Apple 可能只能取得較低的佣金，甚至完全無法取得分潤，這會「實質不利於 Apple 的營收、毛利、營運結果、財務狀況與股價」【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。此分潤結構使開發者在選擇平台時必須考量 Apple 能否提供足夠的收入機會，從而提升黏著度。

- **開發者對平台的感知利益**：Apple 在 10‑K 中指出，開發者在決策是否為 Apple 平台開發時，會比較「感知利益」與「預期可產生的營收」，並將此與 Android、Windows、PlayStation、Nintendo、Xbox 等其他平台的「市場位置」作比較【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。這種比較機制促使 Apple 必須維持或提升其平台的收益潛力與市場形象，以保持開發者的忠誠。

- **市場佔有率的雙刃劍**：文件亦說明 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率相對較低，這「可能使開發者較不願意為 Apple 產品開發或升級軟體，轉而投入市場佔有率較大的競爭平台」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。因此，Apple 必須透過上述的分潤與感知利益機制，彌補市場規模上的不足，才能維持開發者的黏著度。

- **開發者支援對產品需求的影響**：Apple 強調「第三方開發者的支援」是其硬體產品銷售的重要因素；若開發者無法或不願跟上技術變化，可能導致應用無法提供更佳使用者體驗，進而「降低客戶需求」並對營運產生負面衝擊【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。這使 Apple 必須持續確保開發者能在平台上獲得足夠的回報與曝光，從而鞏固生態系的黏著度。

綜合以上，Apple 主要藉由 **App Store 佣金結構、對開發者收益與市場位置的比較評估、以及對開發者支援的重要性宣示**，在相對較低的市場佔有率下，仍努力建立並維持第三方開發者對其生態系的黏著度。

records.answer:
Google 於2026年3月11日完成對 Wiz 的收購，花費約 **295 億美元（$29.5 billion）**【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #50】。  

- 這筆收購的最終購買價格列示為 **294.67 億美元（$29,467 million）**（即 295 億美元（$29.5 billion））【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  
- 購買價格分配如下：無形資產 **83 億美元（$8,300 million）**、商譽 **227.05 億美元（$22,705 million）**，以及假設的淨負債 **$(1,538) million**【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  
- 收購完成後，Wiz 的財務結果已納入 Google Cloud 部門的合併財務報表中【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #154】。  
- 此投資被描述為「由 Google Cloud 推動，以加速我們在多雲與 AI 驅動的安全領域的能力」【GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #85】。  
- 商譽已記錄於 Google Cloud 部門，主要歸因於預期收購後的協同效應，且商譽不可作為稅務抵扣項目【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】。  

因此，Google 為加強 Google Cloud 在多雲與 AI 安全方面的競爭力，投入了約 295 億美元（$29.5 billion），並將相關資產與商譽計入該部門的財務報表，預期透過協同效應提升雲端服務的能力。

records.query: Meta 最新一季總營收成長多少？主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 最新一季（2026 年第二季）總營收較去年同期成長 **28%**【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #63】。  

此成長主要來自 **廣告收入的提升**，公司指出營收增加是「因廣告收入的增加」所致【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #63】；同時 **廣告曝光次數（ad impressions）較去年同期上升 14%**，且 **每則廣告的平均價格上升 12%**，兩者共同推動了廣告收入的成長【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #63】。  

（財報顯示本季營收為 **608.01 億美元（$60,801 百萬）**，去年同期為 **475.16 億美元（$47,516 百萬）**，與上述 28% 成長相符【META_10Q_202606.html, chunk #0】）

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our financial results and key Family metrics for the second quarter of 2026 are set forth below. contexts: [NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

records.query: Tesla 汽車銷售營收最新一季成長多少？主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Tesla 在最新一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的三個月）汽車銷售營收成長 **27%**，較去年同季增加 **42.2 億美元（$4.22 billion）**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #68】。  

成長的主要驅動因素包括：  
- 現金交付量約提升 **25%**，帶動銷售量上升【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #68】；  
- 平均單車售價上升，主要來自銷售組合變化以及美元兌外幣走弱的正面影響【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #68】；  
- 超級自動駕駛（FSD）訂閱收入提升，亦貢獻營收增長【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #68】。  

（參考資料亦顯示同季汽車銷售營收從 **157.87 億美元（$15,787 million）** 增至 **200.06 億美元（$20,006 million）**，增幅 **27%**【TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67】）

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence into the real world, through products and services like FSD (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (including Optimus). As a result of rapidly evolving trade and fiscal policy and geopolitical conflicts, uncertainty in the automotive and energy markets continues, posing risks to our global supply chain and cost structure which could have a meaningfully adverse impact on demand for our products and our profitability. The current tariff regime will have a relatively larger impact on our energy generation and storage business compared to our automotive business. While we prepare for near-term challenges to our business under current policies, we are focused on long-term growth opportunities as we continue to further vertically integrate and localize our supply chain and make prudent investments in infrastructure. records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:

**硬體領先**  
- NVIDIA 的 GPU 具備「數萬個運算核心」以及專為深度學習設計的 Tensor Core，讓 AI 訓練與推論效能遠超傳統處理器【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 2024 年推出的 Blackwell 架構，能將 36 顆 Grace CPU 與 72 顆 Blackwell GPU 以液冷方式結合，形成「資料中心規模」的超大型運算平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- 2026 年的 Blackwell Ultra 平台進一步提升 token 吞吐量並降低每個 token 的成本，較前代 Hopper 具顯著效能提升【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
- 透過 Mellanox（2020 年收購）與自家 DPU 技術，NVIDIA 能將「數十萬顆 GPU 互相連接」成為單一巨型電腦，滿足 AI 大模型的資料傳輸需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

**軟體堆疊與平台**  
- NVIDIA 以 CUDA 為基礎的開發平台支援所有 GPU，並提供數百項領域專屬的軟體庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API，讓開發者能快速部署 AI 工作負載【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- 「NVIDIA AI Enterprise」是一套完整的企業級軟體套件，內含 NIM（提升 token 吞吐）、NeMo（模型微調與安全）與 AI Blueprints（即時可執行的 AI 模板），簡化生成式 AI 應用的開發與部署【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- NVIDIA 亦持續推出開放與專有模型平台（如 Nemotron、Cosmos），加速模型釋出節奏，讓生態系成員能即時使用最新的 AI 技術【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

**生態系與開發者基礎**  
- 全球已有「超過 750 萬名開發者」使用 CUDA 及其他 NVIDIA 軟體工具，形成龐大的技術社群【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- NVIDIA 透過「Inception」計畫、與數百所大學的合作、以及 Deep Learning Institute 的課程，持續培育新創與學術界的 AI 能力【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- 主要雲端服務供應商、AI 模型製造商與企業客戶皆依賴 NVIDIA 的資料中心規模基礎設施與平台，來加速廣告、搜尋、推薦系統與生成式 AI 等服務的交付【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

**研發投入與技術領先**  
- NVIDIA 自成立以來已投入超過 **767 億美元（$76.7 billion）** 的研發資金，持續產出對現代計算與 AI 必不可少的發明與創新【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

綜合以上硬體、軟體、開發者生態與巨額研發投入，NVIDIA 成為 AI 生態系的「唯一全棧」供應商，使得產業普遍依賴其技術，而其他公司難以在短時間內複製這樣的完整優勢。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟透過在 Microsoft 365（包括 Office）中加入 AI‑驅動的功能與服務，直接把人工智慧嵌入到使用者的生產力工具裡【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。

records.query: Google 的 AI 助手現在有整合進搜尋引擎裡嗎？
records.answer:
Google 的 AI 助手已經整合進搜尋引擎，透過「AI Overviews」與「AI Mode」在 Google Search 中提供更自然、具多模態與推理能力的問答體驗【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。  

- 「AI Overviews」讓使用者可以直接在搜尋框輸入任何問題，系統會回傳即時的 AI 回答【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。  
- 「AI Mode」則允許使用者提出更複雜、需要多步推理的問題，利用 Gemini 大型語言模型的先進推理與多模態功能，將多次搜尋合併為一次回應【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。  
- 這些功能顯示 Alphabet 正在將 AI 深度嵌入搜尋產品，並以提升使用者體驗為首要目標【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] [section: Understanding Alphabet’s Financial Results] As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues. Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues. Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure. Continued Investment in Intellectual Property through R&D and Acquisitions: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, and improve our existing offerings across our businesses. Acquisitions and strategic investments remain important elements in our use of capital and contribute to the breadth and depth of our offerings, expand our expertise in engineering and other functional areas, and build strong partnerships around strategic initiatives. records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 結合，朝向「沉浸式、AI 驅動的元宇宙與擴增實境」平台發展，讓使用者在虛擬與現實之間無縫切換，同時透過 AI 助手提升互動與內容推薦能力。  

- **VR 產品路線**：Meta 以 Meta Quest 系列為核心，提供遊戲、健身、娛樂等社交體驗，並加入「passthrough」功能，使使用者在沉浸式 VR 中仍能感知實體世界【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **AI 眼鏡與 AR 原型**：Meta 的穿戴設備包括 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta 眼鏡，以及 2025 年推出的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display（鏡片內嵌顯示）和配套的 Meta Neural Band（透過肌電控制）。2024 年更展示了 Orion 原型，屬於真正的 AR 眼鏡，具備業界領先的視野與舒適佩戴形態【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **AI 助手整合**：Meta AI 作為跨平台助理，已在所有應用程式、獨立 App、AI 眼鏡與網路上提供，協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容與即時連結【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  
- **AI 研發與超級智慧願景**：公司持續投資生成式 AI、前沿 AI 模型與「個人超級智慧」的研發，目標在內容排序、廣告工具、產品開發效率以及未來新產品功能上取得突破【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- **元宇宙長期策略**：Meta 視元宇宙為「下一代計算平台」與社交互動的未來，將 AI、可穿戴裝置與 VR/AR 結合，打造沉浸式、以社交為核心的生態系統【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。  
- **風險與挑戰**：公司亦承認在 Reality Labs（VR/AR）領域的經驗有限，若無法成功開發硬體或取得市場接受，可能影響品牌與財務表現【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。  

綜合以上，Meta 的發展方向是以 VR/AR 硬體為入口，結合高度整合的 AI 助手與生成式 AI 技術，推動元宇宙與擴增實境的生態系統，同時持續評估相關風險。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

--- Business Summary --- Meta Platforms, Inc. engages in the development of products that enable people to connect and share with friends and family through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL). The FoA segment offers Facebook, which enables people to build community through feed, reels, stories, groups, marketplace, and other; Instagram that brings people closer through Instagram feed, stories, reels, live, and messaging; Messenger, a messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls; Meta AI, an assistant that's available across apps, as a stand-alone app, on AI glasses, and on the web; Threads, an application for text-based updates and public conversations; and WhatsApp, a messaging application that is used by people and businesses to communicate and transact. The RL segment provides virtual and augmented reality products, including consumer hardware, software, and content that help people feel connected, as well as Meta Quest devices that enable social experiences across gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. The segment also includes wearables such as AI glasses like Ray Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses; and the Meta Ray Ban Display, which combines AI glasses with an integrated lens display and the Meta Neural Band, a wrist worn device using electromyography that lets people control their AI glasses through neuromuscular signals. Meta Platforms, Inc.

[META 10-K period 2025] In the near term, we are continuing to develop products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced passthrough capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AI glasses and long-term AR initiatives. Our current AI glasses include the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. In general, our Reality Labs efforts include shorter-term projects developing specific products and services to go to market, as well as longer-term research and development projects.

[META 10-K period 2025] Our product development philosophy centers on continuous innovation in creating and improving products that are social by design, which means that our products are designed to place people and their social interactions at the core of the product experience. Historically, the increases in our computing needs have been driven by growth in our user base as well as engagement with products like video and VR. Our increased efforts toward building frontier AI models have driven a significant further expansion in our computing needs and we expect our computing needs to continue to expand as a result. We have designed and built our own data centers and key portions of our technical infrastructure, and a substantial portion of our technical infrastructure is also provided by third parties. Our ability to provide and continue to innovate our products and services depends on the continued availability of components, power, and network capacity. We make significant investments in technology both to improve our existing products and services and to develop new ones, as well as for our marketers and developers. We are also investing in protecting the security, privacy, and integrity of our platform by investing in both people and technology to strengthen our systems against abuse. Across all of these efforts, we are making significant investments in AI initiatives, including generative AI and superintelligence, to, among other things, recommend relevant content across our products through our AI-powered discovery engine, enhance our advertising tools and improve our ad delivery, targeting, and measurement capabilities, and to develop new products as well as new features for existing products. We have a history of open-sourcing in AI, including releasing our Llama foundation models as well as other models and tools, and continue to believe in the power of open source innovation. By sharing these resources, we aim to accelerate AI research, improve our products, and foster innovation across the tech community. We have not released everything we have developed historically and expect to continue training a combination of open and closed models going forward. Sales and Operations 

The majority of our marketers use our self-service ad platform to launch and manage their advertising campaigns. We also have a global sales force that is focused on attracting and retaining advertisers and providing support to them throughout the stages of the marketing cycle from pre-purchase decision-making to real-time optimizations to post-campaign analytics. We work directly with these advertisers, as well as through advertising agencies and resellers. We operate offices in more than 90 cities around the globe, the majority of which have a sales presence. We also invest in and rely on self-service tools to provide direct customer support to our users and partners. For our RL products, our sales efforts utilize third-party sales channels such as retailers, resellers, and distribution partners, and our direct-to-consumer channel, Meta.com, and several Meta stores. These efforts are focused on driving consumer and enterprise sales and adoption of our Meta Quest portfolio of products and AI glasses. 8


Marketing

Historically, our communities have generally grown organically with people inviting their friends to connect with them, supported by internal efforts to stimulate awareness and interest. In addition, we have invested and will continue to invest in marketing our products and services to grow our brand and help build community around the world. Intellectual Property

We believe the metaverse, an embodied internet where people have immersive experiences beyond two-dimensional screens, is the next evolution in social technology. In 2021, we announced a shift in our business and product strategy to focus on helping to bring the metaverse to life, and we are directing our efforts toward innovations in AI, wearables, and devices to help build next-generation interfaces. We expect this will be a complex, evolving, and long-term initiative that will involve the development of new and emerging technologies, continued investment in infrastructure as well as privacy, safety, and security efforts, and collaboration with other companies, developers, partners, and other participants. However, the metaverse may not develop in accordance with our expectations, and market acceptance of features, products, or services we build is uncertain. We regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. In addition, we have relatively limited experience with consumer hardware products and virtual and augmented reality technology, which may enable other companies to compete more effectively than us. We may be unsuccessful in our research and product development efforts, including if we are unable to develop relationships with key participants in the metaverse or develop products that operate effectively with metaverse technologies, products, systems, networks, or standards. For example, some of our consumer hardware products depend on the ability to operate with third-party mobile platforms and these platforms do not necessarily provide our products with the same levels of interoperability that they provide to their own competing products. In addition, our Reality Labs efforts may also divert resources and management attention from other areas of our business. We expect to continue to make significant investments in virtual and augmented reality and other technologies to support these efforts, and our ability to support these efforts is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. In addition, as our Reality Labs efforts evolve, we may be subject to a variety of existing or new laws and regulations in the United States and international jurisdictions, including in the areas of privacy, safety, AI, competition, content regulation, medical devices, tariffs, export controls, consumer protection, and e-commerce, which may delay or impede the development of our products

and services, increase our operating costs, require significant management time and attention, or otherwise harm our business. As a result of these or other factors, our Reality Labs strategy and investments may not be successful in the foreseeable future, or at all, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛之所以被認為較其他車廠更具優勢，主要在於它全程自行研發 AI 演算法與硬體、採用視覺感測與自家設計的推論晶片、透過 OTA 立即升級軟體，且已經在 Model Y 上營運 Robotaxi 服務，這些都使其在自動駕駛生態系統上具備端到端的整合能力，而傳統車廠仍依賴「遺留的手工編碼」方式處理自動駕駛演算法，難以應付其複雜度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29】。

- **全程自行研發 AI 與硬體**：特斯拉使用自家設計的 AI 推論晶片，並以視覺為基礎的感測技術訓練人工神經網路，這些技術均由內部開發並持續優化【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **軟體即服務、OTA 更新**：所有交付的特斯拉車輛皆具備可透過 OTA 進行軟體更新的功能，讓自動駕駛功能可隨時提升與修正，保持技術領先【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **FSD（Supervised）與訂閱模式**：特斯拉的 Full Self‑Driving（FSD）功能以「FSD (Supervised)」或「FSD (Capability)」稱呼，並透過訂閱服務提供給使用者，為未來以 AI、軟體與車隊營運為核心的服務模式奠定基礎【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **Robotaxi 商業化**：2025 年 6 月特斯拉正式推出 Robotaxi 服務，已在 Model Y 上運營，未來將納入自行研發的 Cybercab，展示了特斯拉在自動駕駛即服務（RaaS）領域的先行布局【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **AI 差異化**：特斯拉在文件中明確表示，其 AI 能力與競爭對手不同，認為這是其在自動駕駛市場的關鍵差異化因素【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **傳統車廠的挑戰**：NVDA 在其 10‑K 中指出，傳統的手工編碼方式無法應付自動駕駛所需的複雜演算法，暗示傳統車廠在演算法層面仍受限於舊有開發模式【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29】。  

綜合以上，特斯拉在 AI 演算法、專屬硬體、持續 OTA 軟體升級、已商業化的 Robotaxi 服務以及以 AI 為核心的服務驅動商業模式上，均展現出相較於仍依賴傳統手工編碼開發方式的其他車廠更為先進與完整的優勢。

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[NVDA 10-K period 2026] We believe the advent of autonomous vehicles, or AV, and electric vehicles, or EV, is revolutionizing the transportation industry. The algorithms required for autonomous driving - such as reasoning, perception, localization, and planning - are too complex for legacy hand-coded approaches and will use multiple neural networks instead. Therefore, we provide an AI-based hardware and software solution, designed and implemented from the ground up based on automotive safety standards, for the AV and EV market under the DRIVE brand, which we are bringing to market through our partnerships across the transportation industry including with automotive OEMs, mobility service providers, robotaxis, tier-1 suppliers, and start-ups. Our AV solution also includes the GPU-based hardware required to train the neural networks before their in-vehicle deployment, as well as to re-simulate their operation prior to any over-the-air software updates. We believe our comprehensive, top-to-bottom and end-to-end approach will enable the transportation industry to solve the complex problems arising from the shift to autonomous driving. 7


Leveraging our intellectual property, or IP. We believe our IP is a valuable asset that can be accessed by our customers and partners through license and development agreements when they desire to build such capabilities directly into their own products or have us do so through a custom development. Such license and development arrangements can further enhance the reach of our technology. Sales and Marketing

Our worldwide sales and marketing strategy is key to achieving our objective of providing markets with our high-performance and efficient computing platforms and software. Our sales and marketing teams, located across our global markets, work closely with customers and various industry ecosystems through our partner network. Our partner network incorporates global, regional and specialized CSPs, OEMs, ODMs, ISVs, global system integrators, add-in board manufacturers, or AIBs, distributors, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, and other ecosystem participants. Members of our sales team have technical expertise and product and industry knowledge. We also employ a team of application engineers and solution architects to provide pre-sales assistance to our partner network in designing, testing, and qualifying system designs that incorporate our platforms. For example, our solution architects work with CSPs to provide pre-sales assistance to enable our customers to optimize their hardware and software infrastructure for generative and agentic AI and LLM training and deployment. They also work with foundation model and enterprise software developers to enable our customers to optimize the training and fine-tuning of their models and services, and with enterprise end-users, often in collaboration with their global system integrator of choice, to fine-tune models and build AI applications. We believe that the depth and quality of our design support are key to improving our partner network’s time-to-market, maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction, and fostering relationships that encourage our customers and partner network to use the next generation of our products within each platform. To encourage the development of applications optimized for our platforms and software, we seek to establish and maintain strong relationships in the software development community. Engineering and marketing personnel engage with key software developers to promote and discuss our platforms, as well as to ascertain individual product requirements and solve technical problems. Our developer program supports the development of AI frameworks, SDKs, and APIs for software applications and game titles that are optimized for our platforms. Our Deep Learning Institute provides in-person and online training for developers in industries and organizations around the world to build AI and accelerated computing applications that leverage our platforms. Seasonality

Our computing platforms serve a diverse set of markets such as data centers, gaming, professional visualization, and automotive. Our desktop gaming products typically see stronger revenue in the second half of our fiscal year.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] That means developing AI in a way that maximizes the positive benefits to society while addressing its potential challenges. Moonshots

Many companies get comfortable doing what they have always done, making only incremental changes.
